lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Hey there! Could you spare a moment? My back is really hurting, and I need help clearing these haystacks. I’d really appreciate it.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: You’re doing great. I don’t remember seeing you in this village — actually, I don’t remember anyone for some reason

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: But haystacks are still there. I'am counting on you to clear them all.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: That’s it! I can’t believe you’ve done it. Thank you so much!

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: I’ll give you a reward for your help. Here’s some freshy carrot! I know it will help you with your journey.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: That’s quite funny — I was just about to ask you to help deal with the haystacks, but you’ve already taken care of them yourself. Amazing!

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: In any case, I have this carrot as a reward. Here, take it — you’ve earned it.

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Good work is work well done. I wish I could finally rest — I’m so tired after the whole day?

lines.name: Farmer Joe
lines.text: Have you seen the old big cow? She was grazing in the field, but she’s disappeared somewhere. I hope she’s all right.
